name: E2E Status: Clean Directory Reports Not Initialized
description: Executor runs `node bin/conductor status` with cwd set to an empty temp directory and returns stdout. Passes only if it reports uninitialized instead of inventing tracks.
executor_contract: argv: node bin/conductor status; cwd: empty temp dir; return: stdout text
reference_output: Conductor is not initialized in this directory. Run "conductor setup" to initialize.
reference_how: live run of `node bin/conductor status` in an empty temp dir
